name: Voidwarding reduces party damage taken and raises the caster's resistances natively (#1127)
contract: 560002 effect0 is SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID (native, generic: UnitAura::FillTargetMap pushes the owner plus every grouped unit in range via Acore::AnyGroupedUnitInObjectRangeCheck), aura 87 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN, BasePoints -4 / DieSides 1 -> value -3, matching the tooltip's 3%. Its EffectMiscValue is 127 = all seven school bits (0..6), i.e. every school including SPELL_SCHOOL_MASK_NORMAL/physical -- the audit report's own claim that physical is excluded is wrong (127 = 1+2+4+8+16+32+64 includes bit 0); this scenario asserts what the DBC actually encodes, not the report's text. Effect1 is self aura 83 SPELL_AURA_MOD_BASE_RESISTANCE, BasePoints 4 / DieSides 1 -> base value 5, EffectRealPointsPerLevel 0.5, EffectMiscValue 126 = the six magic-school bits (Holy..Arcane, physical excluded, as resistance itself is a magic-only stat). Both Spell.dbc's SpellLevel and BaseLevel for 560002 are 31; SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue clamps a caster below BaseLevel up to BaseLevel and then subtracts max(BaseLevel, SpellLevel), so a level-31 caster gets exactly the unscaled base rather than needing to reproduce the 0.5/level term. The "does not stack with similar effects" clause (spell_group plumbing) is not covered here; only the two implemented percentage/resistance mechanics are asserted, per the audit's own noted verification limit.

steps.label: Cultist's own Shadow resistance before the talent
Ally's incoming Shadow damage bonus before the talent
Voidwarding raises the caster's own Shadow resistance by 5 at level 31
Voidwarding reduces the grouped ally's incoming Shadow damage bonus by 30 (3% of the fixed 1000 base)
